verdict.rationale: Datalab's structured extraction lets users define a JSON schema and get back typed field values (with bounding-box citations for auditability), plus schema auto-generation and checkpointing to reuse parsed state across calls, which maps directly to producing clean typed JSON for downstream DB loading. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of extraction accuracy on real-world tables and any explicit DB-loading connector or schema-validation guarantees beyond docs.
